'''Florencio Ignacio Utreras Díaz''' (born 25 December 1951,&nbsp;[[Ancud]]) is a Chilean mathematician who is considered to be one of the fathers of the Internet in [[Chile]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.americaeconomia.com/negocios-industrias/florencio-utreras-el-2-de-enero-de-1992-comenzo-el-internet-en-chile-mandamos-un|title=Florencio Utreras: "El 2 de enero de 1992 comenzó el internet en Chile... mandamos un email y nos fuimos a tomar unas cervezas para celebrar"|access-date=28 June 2018|date=8 October 2017|publisher=América economía|last=Aránguiz|first=Cristian|language=es}}</ref><ref name="premio">{{Cite web|url=https://www.internethalloffame.org/inductees/florencio-utreras|title=INTERNET HALL of FAME GLOBAL CONNECTOR Florencio Utreras|access-date=28 June 2018|publisher=Internet Society}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Utreras studied engineering mathematics at the [[University of Chile]], graduating in 1975. Later, in 1979, he earned his doctorate in engineering at&nbsp;[[Université Grenoble Alpes]] in [[France]].

In 1987, he directed the Chilean connection to [[BITNET]], the computer network at&nbsp;[[City, University of London|City University]] in&nbsp;[[New York City]] and&nbsp;[[Yale University]]. In 1992, he contributed to the creation&nbsp;of&nbsp;National University Network ({{ill|REUNA|es}}), the main academic network for Latin America and the Caribbean.<ref name="dinamo">{{cite news|url=https://www.eldinamo.cl/tendencias/2017/09/21/profesor-chileno-ingresa-al-salon-de-la-fama-de-internet/|title=Profesor chileno ingresa al "Salón de la Fama" de internet|access-date=28 June 2018|date=21 September 2017|publisher=El Dínamo|language=es}}</ref>

In 1997, Utreras to start the strategic alliance between REUNA and&nbsp;CTC&nbsp;(now Movistar) to create Reuna2, the broadband network that connected between&nbsp;[[Arica]] and&nbsp;[[Osorno, Chile|Osorno]], at that time the most extensive network in Latin America.<ref name="dinamo" />

In 2003, he was a part of the founding team of the Cooperación Latinoamericana de Redes Avanzadas (Red Clara), a non-profit organization of 17 Latin American nations that brings together the education and research networks of the region. From 1998 to 2002, he was part of the presidential committees of Chile in the&nbsp;[[Internet Society]]&nbsp;and, in 2016, received the recognition of World Telecommunications Day, granted by the Undersecretary of Telecommunications of Chile.<ref name="dinamo" />

In 2017, Utreras was inaugurated into the [[Internet Hall of Fame]] in the Global Connectors category for his important and pioneering contributions to the connectivity of Chile and Latin America to the Internet.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uchile.cl/noticias/137051/profesor-de-la-universidad-de-chile-ingreso-al-internet-hall-of-fame|title=Académico de la U. de Chile ingresó al Internet Hall of Fame como precursor de la red en Latinoamérica|access-date=28 June 2018|date=20 September 2017|last=Fuentes Valencia|first=Cristian|publisher=University of Chile}}</ref>
